segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling customer support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name or account ID?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi, this is Daniel at Ridgeview Analytics. Account ID is 41782. I need the March invoice resent to our AP alias, and the PO number is missing on it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, I’ve got Ridgeview up in the ticketing system. For invoice resend and PO changes, I’m going to transfer you to the billing queue. They can take care of that.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Uh, okay. I’m just trying to get it paid today, so hopefully quick.

segments.speaker: Billing Specialist
segments.text: This is Colin in billing. I have the account pulled up from Maya. You need invoice 23891 resent with a PO added, is that right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, exactly. The PO should be RV-6044, and please send it to ap@ridgeviewanalytics.com. The amount should still be $2,430 for 18 seats.

segments.speaker: Billing Specialist
segments.text: Yep, I see $2,430 on the March 1 invoice. I added PO RV-6044 in the billing tool and resent the PDF to that AP address. You should see it in a minute or two.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it, it just came through. Looks correct. Thanks.

segments.speaker: Billing Specialist
segments.text: No problem. I’ll note ticket 586214 as completed.
